Class Model.InventoryTiles

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.Model.InventoryTiles
Direct Known Subclasses:
Model.ButtonTiles
Enclosing class:
Model
public static class Model.InventoryTiles extends Object
Represents a basic tile item in a player's inventory. Tracks the name of the item and how many have been collected.

  • Constructor Details

    • InventoryTiles

      public InventoryTiles(String name, int index)
      Constructor for InventoryTiles. Pre-condition: Name is valid, index is unique. Post-condition: A new InventoryTile is created with count 0.

      index - The unique index.

      public void setCount(int count)
      Manually sets the count of tiles. Pre-condition: count >= 0. Post-condition: The tile count is updated to the specific value.
      Parameters:
      count - The new count of the tile.

      public int getCount()

    • increaseCount

      protected void increaseCount()
      Increments the count of this specific tile type by exactly 1. Pre-condition: The count is a non-negative integer. Post-condition: The internal count is increased by 1 (count = old_count + 1).
